spend.note: Per-arm ledger figures are the LLMCost window totals and are what the sums use. The harmonize receipts carry a CLI total as well; the two agree everywhere except the visible-wavelength Jev arm, whose receipt reads USD 1.0162 against its ledger's USD 0.841339 (the receipt spans both batches while the ledger window closed after the second). The wall-recombination heuristic arm has no ledger total because its apply died on its own cap; its halt reason records cost_spent USD 1.50578, which is the figure used here. The prior-cut figure is the confirmed spend the first cut of this A/B booked before it stopped on its worker deadline.

condition_fewer_total_lint_across_famili.detail: over the 9 families where both arms completed, heuristic 24 against Jev 21, but the tenth family (energy_flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination) has no heuristic measurement, so the ten-family total the rule names cannot be formed; over the 6 families whose arms reached the same batch the totals are equal at 17

condition_no_lower_member_scores.detail: a Jev-arm member scores below the same member's heuristic-arm value in 9 of 10 families

overall_verdict.verdict: do not adopt the Jev anchor
overall_verdict.reason: the second condition fails outright on complete, like-for-like evidence - every family carrying after-scores in both arms has at least one member scoring lower under the Jev anchor - and the first is not established, since on the families where both arms reached the same batch the lint counts are identical and the tenth family has no heuristic measurement

recommendation: Keep the heuristic anchor rather than adopting the Jev scorer: the Jev arm fails the rule's score condition in nine of ten families and shows no like-for-like lint advantage, so the evidence that would change the call is a re-run holding both arms to the same batch count (or forcing both to a full two of two under a raised per-arm budget) in which the Jev arm ends with strictly fewer lint findings and no member's after-score falls below that member's heuristic-arm value.
